mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(guest_count),0) FROM reservation WHERE slot_id=#{slotId} AND status='CONFIRMED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation WHERE slot_id=#{slotId} AND email=#{email} AND status='CONFIRMED'
SELECT id,slot_id,guest_name,email,guest_count,note,status FROM reservation ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, s.reserved_date, s.start_time, r.guest_name, r.email, r.guest_count, r.note, r.status FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_slot s ON s.id=r.slot_id WHERE r.status='CONFIRMED' ORDER BY s.reserved_date, s.start_time, r.id

SELECT r.id, s.reserved_date, s.start_time, r.guest_name, r.email, r.guest_count, r.note, r.status FROM reservation r JOIN reservation_slot s ON s.id=r.slot_id WHERE r.status='CONFIRMED' AND s.reserved_date=#{date} ORDER BY s.start_time, r.id
